notes:
Inbound lead via docs search blog CTA. SMB, direct-to-consumer home goods. Founder/CTO: Maya Singh (hands-on).
Key ask: product Q&A widget on product pages + automated metadata extraction to fill attributes (dimensions, materials, care).
Behavior: mostly self-serve so far — they spun up Hosted API and started small batch ingest. Early qual: interested in low friction, predictable token costs, decent latency during promotions.
Quoted from call: "We need answers on PDP in <200ms for most queries — customers bounce if search is slow during flash sales."
Technical context: Shopify Plus storefront with periodic flash sales (10x baseline traffic for 2-6 hours). Catalog ~12k SKUs, images hosted CDN, product descriptions inconsistent. Current search = Elasticsearch hosted; team wants LLM Q&A overlay + semantic search for tutorial content.
Constraints: prefer public cloud hosted product for now (no VPC). SOC2 is a checkbox for their payments/ops team; need audit log visibility and simple retention controls.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — will start with low-commit Hosted API and move to Dedicated only if consistent high throughput and predictable unit cost.
Open questions: 1) exact per-token pricing for continuous batching scenarios, 2) built-in burst handling and rate-limiting strategies, 3) data retention guarantees and deletion flow for ingested catalog vectors.
Action items recorded: AE to send pricing + example cost calc for their 12k SKU catalog; SE to create sample ingestion script and run a 48h POC to show latency profiles and token consumption.
